choices.title: Extension Manager
choices.description: Install and update GNOME extensions with a friendly graphical app (Flathub). Core tool for Kuhl.

choices.title: GNOME Tweaks + Extensions
choices.description: Adjust fonts, windows and desktop preferences; GNOME Extensions handles installed add-ons.

choices.title: Kuhl Day/Dusk look
choices.description: Wallpaper, Papirus icons, consistent fonts, warm accent and matching shell CSS. Includes User Themes.

choices.title: Dash to Dock
choices.description: Persistent configurable launcher dock. Can be turned off from Extension Manager.

choices.title: Just Perfection
choices.description: Fine-grained GNOME panel, overview and animation layout controls.

choices.title: AppIndicator
choices.description: Show tray icons for apps using legacy status indicators.

choices.title: Tiling Assistant
choices.description: More flexible window snapping, grids and tiling shortcuts.

choices.title: Caffeine
choices.description: Prevent the screen from dimming or suspending when you need it awake.

choices.title: Blur my Shell
choices.description: Blurred overview, menus and shell surfaces. May use more GPU resources.

choices.title: Rounded Window Corners
choices.description: Soft rounded corners for many windows. May conflict with other shell effects.

choices.title: Flatseal
choices.description: View or change Flatpak app sandbox permissions with a GUI.

choices.title: Pika Backup
choices.description: Simple, encrypted backups to a local drive or remote location.

choices.title: VLC
choices.description: Media player for most common audio and video formats.

choices.title: LibreOffice
choices.description: Full offline documents, spreadsheets and presentations suite; large download.

choices.title: Kuhl logo on login screen
choices.description: Add a small Kuhl logo to the GDM login screen via supported dconf settings. Does not theme GDM background.

choices.title: Reboot when finished
choices.description: Recommended: restart GNOME so new extensions and themes become discoverable. You'll confirm again after installation.
